title: EventBus callback failure selective recovery contract

contract.callback_failure_isolated: A listener callback failure does not abort EventBus.emit()
contract.selective_recovery: The failing owner can be selectively unregistered without affecting remaining listeners
contract.post_unregister_delivery: Remaining listeners continue receiving events after selective unregister
contract.removed_listener_isolation: An unregistered listener receives no subsequent events
contract.reregistration_recovery: The removed owner can register again successfully
contract.duplicate_idempotency: Duplicate registration does not create duplicate listener entries
contract.restored_broadcast: After re-registration, all owners receive the subsequent broadcast exactly once
contract.registry_integrity: Registry remains structurally valid throughout failure, unregister, re-register, and final broadcast
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration, unregister, and emit operations require the events permission
